item.title: Write My Talking Sale Pitch

turns.text: Make this photo of me say something about our sale. You write the line—keep it upbeat and don't invent discounts, dates or products. An 8-second square talking video, friendly male English voice, no captions.

item.tests: Tests autonomous short sale-copy writing and talking-head output without inventing offer details or asking for a script.

answer_sheet.Source person: Me, the grey-haired man in portrait-man.jpg.
answer_sheet.Sale details: Mention our sale generally; do not invent discounts, dates or products.

must_haves: The talking presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man in the attached photo.
An audible, coherent, agent-written English line invites viewers to check out the sale.
The speech contains no invented discount, sale date, product, or other specific offer claim.
The man's mouth visibly moves in sync with the spoken line.
The result is one square, 8-second video with a friendly male voice and no captions.

turns.text: Could you make this pic of me into a talking video where I say something about our sale? I always overthink these little sale messages, so I’d really appreciate having you handle the wording. You can write the line yourself, and somewhere in all of that I need it to be an 8-second square video with a friendly male English voice. Keep the message upbeat and mention our sale generally, without inventing any discounts, dates or products. I’m just hoping it feels welcoming rather than like I’m making a big fuss about it. Please don’t include any captions.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make the video. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits, so it turned the request down and nothing was created.

Here's the line I wrote. It's about 8 seconds when spoken, upbeat without being pushy, and it doesn't mention any discounts, dates or products:

> "Hi there! Our sale is on now. Come on in, take a look around, and find something you love. See you soon!"

Once you've added credits or upgraded your plan, I can make it in one go with these settings:
- **Your photo** as the speaker. It's already square, so the video will be square too.
- **8 seconds** long, using the free-plan video settings.
- **The line above**, spoken in English.
- **No captions.** This tool doesn't add any text on screen.

There's no setting to choose the voice. It's picked from the photo, so it should come out male, but I can't guarantee it will sound friendly.

If you'd like different wording, tell me and I'll change it before we try again.
